From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Procurement corridor: Renewal onboarding + capacity uplift (Delta Health)

Hi Lisa —

Following up on our Q2 renewal conversation. Delta's current term ends 2029-06-30; per the account plan you indicated you want to: (1) extend term 12 months, (2) double committed capacity to cover a planned pilot, and (3) refresh vendor onboarding artifacts in your procurement portal so finance can issue the PO.

Attached is the current SOW (Delta_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf) with proposed capacity uplift. Can you confirm the vendor registration steps your procurement team needs from us? Specifically: company legal name/EIN, SOC 2 attestation, standard terms redline, and an invoicing contact. If there are portal links or a supplier invite, please point me to them and I’ll get our procurement coordinator to complete the intake.

If it helps, proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- 5/29: Redwood submits updated SOW + vendor intake form (attached)
- 6/03: Legal review complete (Delta)
- 6/10: PO submitted by Delta, Redwood to confirm capacity provisioning

Jordan and Marissa are copied to help with PO cadence and onboarding.

Thanks — looking to keep this low-friction for your procurement team.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0176

Attachments: Delta_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf, Delta_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx

From: Lisa Taylor <lisa.taylor@deltahealth.com>

Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 10:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement corridor: Renewal onboarding + capacity uplift (Delta Health)

Priya —

Thanks for the clear plan. A couple quick items from procurement: we need the SOW to call out the new seat counts and the billing cadence (monthly vs. annual). Our supplier intake process requires: legal entity name + EIN, a copy of your SOC 2 Type II (or the attestation PDF), an up-to-date W9, and a primary invoicing email. We also need a link to your standard terms so our legal team can review redlines.

Can you attach an updated SOW with the uplift broken down line-item by SKU (so the finance team can map to expense codes)? Also please complete the attached vendor intake form and return. I’ve attached Delta_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx for your convenience.

If Redwood can accept our procurement portal invite we use for suppliers that speeds things up — otherwise procurement will take the manual intake route which adds 3–5 business days.
